extension.summary: Channels DVR Hub: Dashboard, guide, recordings and passes for Kodi
extension.description: Channels DVR Hub is an ALPHA client for Kodi 21 Omega only, connecting to a user-configured Channels DVR. Connected DVR functionality remains untested for this candidate. Its Program entry opens a Dashboard with Guide, Recordings, Scheduled, Pass list, Search and Connection navigation. Explicit Play hands completed DVR recordings and advertised live channels to Kodi's native player; OK keeps opening details. Live tuning requires confirmation because shared tuner availability is unknown. Schedule future recordings and manage programme-only and Series passes with separate confirmations and verified local consent. Series management supports Name, pause/resume and removal, including explicit adoption of existing supported passes. Advanced rule editing, DVR resume/watched synchronization and native PVR replacement are not provided. Historical native results from earlier Hub builds and the old EPG identity do not establish acceptance of this 0.1.4 candidate.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial ALPHA add-on for Kodi 21 Omega only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Channels or Fancy Bits, LLC. Project support: https://github.com/kcook98765/script.channelsdvr.hub/issues . Playback, scheduling, pass management and connected DVR behavior have not been natively accepted for this release. Use only your own authorized DVR and content with the required subscription and server build. Channels DVR may use another available source. Preview matches do not guarantee future coverage. Saved rules stay on the DVR after you exit Kodi. Private operation history is retained; no automatic changes or retries.
extension.news: 0.1.4 unpublished ALPHA candidate: Dashboard presentation only. Removes elapsed server runtime, repeated card/listing status and routine refresh copy. One localized absolute Last updated label and one separate partial/failed/stale warning; statistics scheduling, internal freshness and listing views unchanged. No connected/native acceptance is claimed. 0.1.3 ALPHA: coordinated Dashboard statistics refresh. 0.1.2 ALPHA: project support route, original artwork and Omega-only alpha limitations. 0.1.1: shared numeric IP normalization. 0.1.0: separate Hub add-on/profile identity. Earlier Hub and EPG observations remain historical.
